name: petri-net-alignment
description:
(opt18) Name: Petri-net Alignment
submitted by: Massimiliano de Leoni and Andrea Marrella

Description: This domain models the problem of conformance checking on Petri Nets. Given
an input Petri Net and an event log, it determines whether the petri net models the event.
In the original work, the authors introduced noise by permuting actions in the Petri
Net. For the IPC we also introduced noise by mixing several traces together.

Publication: Aligning Real Process Executions and Prescriptive Process Models through
Automated Planning. Massimiliano de Leoni and Andrea Marrella.  Expert Systems with
Applications, 2017.


Interesting properties: 0-cost actions, pre-grounded in PDDL
